item.multibrewer.efficiency_upgrade.tip: Each one adds a 15% chance to keep fuel, redstone and glowstone
item.multibrewer.potency_upgrade.tip: Redstone adds another +25% time; every 2 make glowstone add +1 level
gui.multibrewer.hint: Put in potions and an ingredient, or 2-3 potions to mix them. The Brewer's Guide explains it all
guide.multibrewer.0.title: Brewer's Guide
guide.multibrewer.0.text: The Multi Brewer brews like a normal brewing stand, and also mixes several potions into one and makes them last longer and hit harder than usual.
guide.multibrewer.1.title: Slots
guide.multibrewer.1.text: Above the flask: the ingredient. Below it: three potions. On the right: the mixed potion. On the left: blaze powder, redstone and glowstone. Bottom right: upgrades.
guide.multibrewer.2.title: Normal brewing
guide.multibrewer.2.text: Put water bottles or potions below and an ingredient on top, like a normal brewing stand. All recipes work, even from other mods.
guide.multibrewer.3.title: Mixing
guide.multibrewer.3.text: Put 2-3 potions in with no ingredient. All their effects end up in one potion. The same effect adds its time; the stronger level wins. Empty bottles come back.
guide.multibrewer.4.title: Redstone & glowstone
guide.multibrewer.4.text: Redstone makes effects last 50% longer. Glowstone adds +1 level, up to X. Works with a single potion too.
guide.multibrewer.5.title: Upgrades
guide.multibrewer.5.text: Speed: 30% faster each. Efficiency: a chance to keep fuel and ingredients. Potency: redstone and glowstone work harder. Up to 4 per slot.
guide.multibrewer.6.title: Fuel & hoppers
guide.multibrewer.6.text: One blaze powder lasts 20 brews. Hoppers can put in potions, fuel and ingredients and take out finished potions and bottles.
guide.multibrewer.7.title: Tips
guide.multibrewer.7.text: Splash and lingering potions stay that way. Hover a slot or the flask for a hint. Every potion recipe is on the panel beside the brewer.
